text:
elaine.product: Heads-up — draft for microtier launch requires an explicit SLA carveout for regulated pilots. can we call out gating criteria + what counts as an exception?
marco.sales: yep saw this. customers asking for 99.9 SLA only if they take 'priority-lane' add-on and sign 12mo minimum.
priya.research: on the perf side, priority-lane is mostly routing + reserved burst; it doesn't change model quality. need cost carveout though.
alex.finance: financial constraint: any SLA credit must be capped at 10% ARR for microtiers. otherwise we blow headroom for pilots.
dan.revops: also need to define soft vs hard caps on usage — microtiers should have per-route soft throttle, with buy-up path. exceptions for field pilots must be logged and date-limited.
jina.eng: technical note — we can spin a per-tenant reserve for priority-lane but it'll require a new autoscale policy. estimate 2 sprints to stabilize.
elaine.product: proposal: microtiers = [Starter, Growth, Priority-addon]. Starter: no SLA; Growth: 99.5 default; Priority-addon: 99.9 SLA if 12mo commit. gating: >$5k MRR or sales-escrow approval.
marco.sales: can we make the MRR threshold flexible for strategic partners? sometimes we do pilot for channel partners below $5k.
alex.finance: flexible on a case-by-case but require finance sign-off + a refundable pilot deposit.
dan.revops: operationally we need an "SLA carveout" template for contracts + a tracking tag in billing so we can automatically apply credits.
priya.research: quick ask — do we want telemetry changes? to measure priority-lane SLOs we need per-route p95/p99 exported to console. that's extra infra.
jina.eng: yes, we need those metrics. I'll put up a small schema change: add labels {tenant_tier, addon_priority} and emit p95/p99. simple.
elaine.product: nice. launch checklist items I want captured before beta: 1) pricing matrix in docs 2) contract template w/ carveout 3) revops billing tag 4) priority-lane autoscale + metrics 5) finance guardrail on credits
alex.finance: add: define max credit cap per tenant and per-quarter reconciliation process.
marco.sales: also: negotiated discounts must not implicitly grant SLA without addon. we see confusion in EMEAs. need clear language.
dan.revops: I'll draft the billing tag and credit cap logic. tagging format suggestion: `tier:micro,addon:priority,slacarveout:true`
priya.research: FYI — some customers care about quantization-induced quality regressions at lower-cost grads. we should note that priority-lane is not a quality guarantee. add to docs.
elaine.product: good call. quick mock pricing snippet for the docs (for discussion):
```
Starter: $0/mo, 100k tokens, no SLA
Growth: $499/mo, 2M tokens, 99.5% (soft throttle at 95% of quota)
Priority Add-on: +$2k/mo reserved capacity, 99.9% SLA with 12mo commit, per-tenant burst pool
```
marco.sales: I like it but we need a micro-commit pilot option: 3mo pilot w/ deposit and reduced SLA (99.7) to get customers onboard.
elaine.product: can do as "pilot option" with explicit expiration and manual opt-in to full SLA after commit. add to launch criteria.
jina.eng: dev blocker: autoscale policy + telemetry + billing tag — plan: 2 sprints for infra, 1 sprint for docs+contracts after.
dan.revops: ops blocker: need one-time migration script to backfill existing pilot tenants for tracking. I'll prep runbook.
alex.finance: decision time: SLA credit cap = min(10% of trailing 12mo revenue, $50k) for microtiers. agree?
marco.sales: :+1:
elain.product: (typo) meant elaine — :thumbsup:
priya.research: small ask: surface a "quality note" next to pricing that explains quantization vs latency tradeoffs. Helps sales set expectations.
elaine.product: agreed. next steps: dan to spec billing tag + template, jina to schedule infra work, alex to finalize credit cap language. I'll assemble a launch criteria doc and ping legal for contract clause.
bot-deploy: Reminder: #prod-deploy scheduled for 2026-01-15 18:00 UTC — blocking infra changes must be merged by 2026-01-08.
marco.sales: cc @channel — can we get a 30-minute alignment on Wed? I'll send calendar invite with agenda: pricing snippet, SLA carveouts, pilot flow, sales messaging.
elaine.product: thanks — putting action items in the roadmap. will follow up with a slim PRD and a list of accept criteria.
